question: Do five further untested families (pairs trading, session timing, 8h cross-sectional reversal, high-volatility breakout, volatility-managed momentum) earn positive net returns on a broad crypto universe, and in which regimes?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-01 before any result of these families. One a-priori parameter set each, nothing searched. Same samples, costs, funding, halves, regimes and pass rules as strategy-zoo-v1 (config/strategy_zoo_v1.json). Intraday (8h) books also report gross returns because costs are expected to dominate them. The Z2/Z4 mirror ideas from zoo v1 are deliberately NOT included (chosen after seeing data).
trial_family: strategy-zoo-v2 (5 families, one parameter set each)

design.design_effect_bps: not estimated; Newey-West 5 lags on daily portfolio returns
design.design_units: daily portfolio net returns (8h books summed per UTC day)

strategies.Y1_pairs: every 7 days pair coins greedily by highest 90-day correlation of daily log returns (non-overlapping, at most floor(N/4) pairs, correlation >= 0.7); spread = log price ratio, z-score over 20 days; open short-rich/long-cheap when |z| > 2, close when |z| < 0.5 or the pair is dropped; each active pair gets gross 1 / max pairs, split equally between legs
strategies.Y2_us_session: 8h bars: hold the equal-weight basket long only in the bar that opens 16:00 UTC (US afternoon), flat otherwise
strategies.Y3_8h_reversal: 8h bars: cross-sectional, rank coins by their previous 8h return, long the bottom quartile and short the top quartile, rebalanced every 8h bar
strategies.Y4_highvol_breakout: per coin, daily: when the coin's 20-day realized vol is above its prior 180-day median, enter long on a close above the prior 20-day high of opens or short below the prior 20-day low; exit on the opposite 10-day extreme; size min(1, 15% / annualized 60-day vol), divided by the number of coins with data
strategies.Y5_volmanaged_xs_momentum: the frozen 30-day/7-day cross-sectional momentum book (multi-premia S2) scaled each day by min(1, 20% / its own trailing 30-day annualized vol, prior days only); scale-down only, never leverage

pass_rules: identical to strategy-zoo-v1: development mean > 0, NW t >= 2 and both halves positive; confirmation Sharpe > 0 and NW t >= 1.5; Bonferroni label at t >= 2.7 (5 tests: 2.58, reported at 2.7 for consistency with v1)
